A payment void restores paid totals, eroded and final-zeroed reserve and the deductible
Totals are SUMs over the reserve lines; incurred = paid + open reserve - recovered

programs.purpose: Claim financial transactions. Every movement of money on a claim is a CLM_TRANSACTION row against a reserve line (exposure x cost type x category): reserve changes (RSV), payments (PAY) with their check, deductible withheld (DED), recovery reserves (RRSV) and recovery receipts (RCV). Amounts over the user's authority are held pending approval (PAPR) with an approval activity for the first supervisor able to approve them. After every posting the exposure and claim totals are recomputed from the reserve lines.

rules.text: Policy number numeric 1-999999999
Loss date valid and not in the future
Loss older than 3 years refused (outside reporting limitation)
Loss reported after 30 days is accepted with a late warning
Loss time HH:MM, not in the future when the loss is today
Loss type, cause, how reported and relation are code-table values
Description at least 10 characters; blank lines
UK postcode: outward 2-4 chars starting with a
Reporter surname, phone and relation required
Phone 10-15 digits; digits, spaces, + - ( )
Policy not in force at loss needs the coverage override and sets coverage-in-question
Billing DLNQ/CANC sets coverage- in-question; PDUE warns only
Property and commercial losses need a postcode
Policy without coverages sets coverage-in-question
PF5 only for exactly the entry that was verified
Reported date is today; how reported defaults to PHON
Service RC >= 90 backs out the unit of work

programs.purpose: First notice of loss in two steps. ENTER validates the loss details on the screen, verifies the policy (CLMPOLVR POLVRF) and shows insured, period, coverages and billing status. PF5 creates the claim (CLMCLAIM CLMNEW) from the verified entry and shows the claim number, segment and assigned adjuster. PF4 inquiry on the new claim (XCTL CLMINQP) PF12 cancel / start a new FNOL; PF3 menu.

rules.text: Incidents only on draft or open claims
Incident types VEH PROP INJ FIXP
Severity 1..5, default 1
Estimated damage cannot be negative
Vehicle registration must match the named risk unit; with no risk unit a matching insured vehicle is linked, otherwise third-party
One vehicle incident per registration per claim
PROP incidents must name an insured risk unit; FIXP never does
Injury incidents need an injured contact and a valid injury type; the contact is linked INJURED
Incident type and claim cannot change after creation
Total-loss flag is owned by CLMTOTLS; a damage change on a total loss asks for re-evaluation
Damage or injury changes re-run claim segmentation (CLMSEGMT)

programs.purpose: Incident service. Records what was damaged or who was hurt on a claim: vehicle (VEH), insured property (PROP), third-party fixed property (FIXP) and injury (INJ) incidents. Vehicle incidents are matched to the policy risk units by registration; unmatched vehicles are third-party. A change in estimated damage re-runs claim segmentation. Total-loss evaluation is CLMTOTLS.

rules.text: Claim number required, 6-12 letters/digits starting with a letter
Exposures shown 8 per page; paging stops at first and last page
PF4 needs the cursor on an exposure row of an open exposure
SIU referral, litigation, duplicate suspicion and coverage in question are alerted
Notes: newest 5 shown; the service filters confidential ones
Page/notes/financials act only on the claim on display; a changed claim number needs ENTER first
Financials are refused for a closed claim
Back out the task's unit of work on RC >= 90

programs.purpose: Claim summary by claim number (CLMCLAIM CLMINQ): header, owner, segment/severity, flags, totals and up to 10 exposures, 8 per page. PF7/PF8 page the exposures; PF4 opens the financials screen for the exposure under the cursor; PF10 lists the latest notes (CLMNOTE0 NTELST) in the message area; PF3 menu.

rules.text: Matters only on an OPEN claim
Matter type SUIT, ARBITRAT or MEDIATN; a SUIT needs court and case number
File date valid, not before the loss date and not in the future
Attorneys must be ATTORNEY contacts on the claim
Case number unique among the claim's open matters
Claim carries the litigation flag
Claim moves to the litigation group supervisor (regional group preferred) unless already there
New matter raises LITOPEN activities and re-segments
Trial date valid and after the file date
Legal spend is cumulative and never decreases
Only OPEN matters can change
Resolution SETTLED needs a settlement, DISMISSD none, JUDGMNT any award >= 0
Flag clears only when no other matter on the claim is open

programs.purpose: Litigation matters. Opening a matter flags the claim as litigated, transfers it to the litigation group supervisor, raises the LITOPEN workflow and re-segments the claim. Matters are updated through to trial and closed with a resolution; the claim flag clears with the last open matter.

rules.text: Option must be 1-4
Claim number is left-justified, starts with a letter, 6-12 letters/digits, no blanks
Inquiry (2) needs a claim number
Exposure seq 1-999 and only with a claim number for option 3
FNOL and activities start without a claim; any claim entered is not passed so it cannot be mistaken for the claim being created

programs.purpose: ClaimsCore main menu. Validates the option and the optional claim number / exposure sequence and transfers control (XCTL) to the chosen screen, handing the claim on in the navigation block. Screens return here with PF3 and may pass a message that is shown on line 23. FUNCTIONS : 1 FNOL (CLMFNLP) 2 inquiry (CLMINQP) 3 financials (CLMFINP) 4 activities (CLMACTP)

rules.text: Topic must be an active NOTETOP code
Body text is mandatory
Confidential notes are allowed only for topics LEGAL, SIU and MEDICAL
Subject defaults to the topic description
Exposure must belong to the claim
Confidential notes are visible only to the claim owner and the owner's supervisor
Confidential notes are sealed in the audit chain and noted in history without their content
Newest 10 notes (cursor limits the fetch)

programs.purpose: Claim notes. Adds topic-coded notes (optionally confidential) and lists the newest notes for a claim, withholding confidential notes from users who are neither the claim owner nor the owner's supervisor.

rules.text: Policy is in force when ISSUEDATE <= loss <= EXPIRYDATE
Missing EXPIRYDATE = open-ended; missing ISSUEDATE = unverifiable
Endowment is not a P&C policy: VERIFIED 'N' reason LIFEPOL
Motor COLL/COMP limit = vehicle value, deductibles 250 / 100
Motor third-party limits fixed: LIAB_BI 5,000,000 and LIAB_PD 1,000,000
Physical damage cover needs an insured value greater than zero
House DWELLING limit = value, deductible 500
House CONTENTS limit = 30% of dwelling value, deductible 250
Commercial perils count only when their premium is greater than 0
Commercial BLDG sum insured = premium x peril multiplier, max 10,000,000; flood raises excess
Commercial BUSINT limit = 25% of BLDG, minimum 25,000
Verified only when at least one coverage could be built
Billing status = latest inbound BILSTAT for the policy, else UNKN
DLNQ / CANC billing on an in- force policy -> STATUS 'BILL' and warning RC 04
First warning raised wins; later warnings never overwrite it

programs.purpose: Policy verification against IBM GenApp. Reads the policy, its customer and its line table (MOTOR / HOUSE / COMMERCIAL), decides whether the policy was in force on the loss date, builds the claim-time coverage and risk unit picture and reports the latest billing status received from BillingCore (BILSTAT events).

rules.text: Recoveries only on an OPEN claim
No subrogation when the insured is 100% at fault (FAULT INSD)
Liability percent 0.01 - 100.00
Adverse party must exist and is linked to the claim as ADVERSE
Estimated recovery = claim total paid x liability percent
Recovery reserve tracks the estimated recovery (RCVRSV)
One subrogation per claim; only OPEN subrogation can change
Close outcome RECOVERD, PARTIAL or ABANDOND; RECOVERD / PARTIAL need a receipt, ABANDOND none
Closing releases the remaining recovery reserve (RCVRSV 0)
Salvage only for a total-loss incident on the claim
Salvage vendor must be a SALVAGE vendor not hit by sanctions
Sale amount > 0, sale date on or after assignment and not in the future; books SALVAGE receipt
Insured owes the deductible not yet applied to paid exposures
Deductible owed is reserved once and billed by DEDBILL event

programs.purpose: Recoveries. Subrogation against an adverse party (open / update / close with outcome), salvage of total-loss incidents (assign to a salvage vendor / record the sale) and deductible recovery from the insured, billed through BillingCore. Every recovery amount is booked as a recovery reserve or receipt through CLMFINTX.

rules.text: Base segment by loss type: AUTO AUTOSTD, PROP PROPSTD, LIAB LIAB, all at severity 2
AUTO fast track: glass or single vehicle, damage < 2,500, no injury, no total loss, no litigation -> AUTOFT severity 1
Any injury -> AUTOCX (auto) or LIAB (other), severity >= 3
A fatality is always maximum severity
Total loss -> severity >= 4 (auto total loss is AUTOCX)
Property in a catastrophe -> PROPCAT severity >= 3
Property damage > 50,000 -> PROPCX severity >= 4
Litigation (flag or open matter) -> severity 5
Severity never below the worst incident severity, never above 5
A closed claim keeps the segment it closed with
Exposures with no segment or the old claim segment follow the claim
Severity rising to 4+ on an open claim raises event SEVESC

programs.purpose: Claim segmentation and severity. Derives the handling segment and a 1..5 severity from the loss type and cause, the incidents recorded so far (injury, fatality, damage, total loss), litigation and catastrophe tagging, then stores them on the claim and cascades the segment to exposures that follow the claim segment.

rules.text: Closed claims are not scored
Only ACTIVE rules score; points come from CLM_SIU_RULE
Each evaluation replaces all score rows of the claim
LATERPT reported more than 30 days after the loss
NEWPOL loss within 30 days of policy inception
PRIORCL other claims on the same policy in the 12 months to loss
HIVALTL total loss with incident damage over 25,000
Theft on a Saturday or Sunday (ISO 6 / 7)
NOPOLREF theft / vandalism with no police report received
Total >= 50 refers the claim: SIU_STATUS REFR, SIUREF workflow, history and audit chain; a claim already with SIU keeps its status

programs.purpose: Special Investigation Unit (fraud) scoring. Walks the active CLM_SIU_RULE rows, evaluates each indicator implemented here against the claim, policy snapshot, prior claims, incidents and documents, replaces the claim's score rows, and refers the claim to SIU when the total reaches the referral threshold.

rules.text: Service type APPRAISL, LEGAL, REPAIR, RENTAL or TOW
Requests need an OPEN claim and an open exposure of that claim
Auto-pick: preferred vendors of the service type, highest rating, loss postcode area match first
Named vendor must be of the service type and sanction-clear
One active request per exposure and service type
Quote / invoice amounts > 0; only RQST or QUOT requests change
Invoice pays the vendor: cost type EXAO for appraisal / legal, CLMC for repair / rental / tow
Invoice more than 10% over the quote completes with a warning
The vendor is linked to the claim in role VENDOR

programs.purpose: Vendor service requests (appraisal, legal, repair, rental, tow). Picks the best preferred vendor when none is named, records the quote and on completion pays the vendor invoice through CLMFINTX against the exposure.

rules.text: Only vehicle incidents on OPEN claims are evaluated
Only insured vehicles (a risk unit with an insured value) are evaluated; third-party vehicles are valued by their own insurer
A damage estimate is required
Total loss when estimated damage >= 70% of insured value
Total loss when the vehicle is not driveable and damage >= 60% of insured value
Thresholds are basis-point rates applied through CLMMONEY
Evaluation never removes a total loss flag; that is a manual review
The claim is a total loss when any of its vehicles is
Salvage hint (25% of insured value) written to claim history
A new total loss re-runs claim segmentation (CLMSEGMT)

programs.purpose: Vehicle total-loss evaluation. Compares the estimated damage on an insured-vehicle incident with the risk unit's insured value; when the repair is uneconomic the incident and the claim are flagged total loss, segmentation is re-run and a salvage hint is written to claim history. Shares the incident body (CLMCINC) with CLMINCDT.
